steps: Read the raw RCSB PDB file without modifying it; verify its SHA-256 checksum.
Keep model 1 and only the protease chain (chain A).
Remove the co-crystallised inhibitor N3 (chain C), which is covalently bonded to Cys145 in the crystal; Cys145 is kept as a free cysteine.
Remove all 84 crystallographic waters and any other non-protein residues.
Remove any hydrogens present so they are rebuilt consistently.
Write the cleaned heavy-atom receptor as PDB.

Run Meeko mk_prepare_receptor: match each residue to a template, add polar hydrogens, assign Gasteiger charges and AutoDock atom types, and write a rigid receptor PDBQT. Histidines use Meeko's default HIE protonation state.
